title: Blender Sculpting - Chisel Scales VDM Brushes Volume 01
description:
Take your Blender sculpting workflow further with Chisel Scales VDM Brush Pack 1, a collection of 22 detailed VDM brushes made for creating unique and complex surface details quickly.

- 22 Detailed Brushes – Create scales, chiseled patterns, cracks, folds, organic textures, and other intricate sculpting details.

- Fast Sculpting – Add complex details with a few strokes instead of manually sculpting repetitive patterns.

- Perfect for Creatures – Great for dragons, reptiles, monsters, animals, fantasy characters, armor, and detailed skin.

- Versatile Collection – Combine different brushes to create unique surfaces for characters, props, rocks, and other 3D assets.
